actions.name: bulk_load
actions.title: Bulk load from an on-prem file
actions.description: Bulk load rows into a table in SQL Server from an on-prem file
actions.help: This action loads an on-prem CSV data file into a table in SQL Server.

input.name: table
input.label: Table name
input.hint: Only first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: file_url
input.label: File URL
input.hint: The URL of an on-prem file that should be a csv file containing data columns in the same order they are specified in database table

input.name: advanced_configuration
input.label: Advanced configuration

properties.name: first_row
properties.label: First row number
properties.hint: Index of the first row in the file to process. Defaults to 1 (first row). If your data contains a header as the first row, set this to 2 to skip the header row.

properties.name: field_quote
properties.label: Field quote
properties.hint: Quote character for fields. If not specified, standard double-quote character is used.

properties.name: field_terminator
properties.label: Field terminator
properties.hint: Terminator symbol to separate fields. The default field terminator is Comma .

properties.name: allow_inserts_on_error
properties.label: Allow partial inserts on error?
properties.hint: If No, then no data is inserted if an error occurs. If Yes, then all the data up to the point of the errored row is inserted. Defaults to No. Learn more .

properties.name: batch_size
properties.label: Batch size
properties.hint: Sets the number of rows in a batch. Rows will be gradually inserted, batch by batch. Defaults to 10000 . Learn more .

properties.name: single_transaction
properties.label: Insert in a single batch?
properties.hint: If set to Yes , all rows are inserted in a single batch and 'Batch size' is ignored. Defaults to No . Learn more .

properties.name: last_row
properties.label: Last row number
properties.hint: Index of the last row in the file to process. Defaults to 0 (final row)

properties.name: fire_triggers
properties.label: Fire triggers
properties.hint: Indicate if triggers should be fired upon data insertion. Defaults to No .

properties.name: keep_nulls
properties.label: Keep null values
properties.hint: Indicate how to treat empty values in the file. If No, default column values will be inserted. If Yes, NULL values are inserted. Defaults to Yes .

properties.name: data_file_type
properties.label: Data file type
properties.hint: Defines the character encoding for the data file. Defaults to Char

input.hint: Configure advanced parameters for the bulk load operation
